Where are new keratinocytes made?
Stratum basale — daughter cells pushed upward, terminally differentiate over ~28–45 days
Which skin layer provides water barrier?
Stratum corneum — lipid bilayers between corneocytes (ceramides dominant)
Eccrine vs apocrine sweat: which for thermoregulation?
Eccrine (entire body, cholinergic sympathetic). Apocrine is vestigial scent gland.
What photon wavelength activates vitamin D synthesis?
UVB (290–315 nm) converts 7-dehydrocholesterol to pre-D3 in stratum spinosum
What cell links skin to immune system?
Langerhans cells (epidermal DCs) — sample antigens, migrate to lymph nodes
When does a wound reach max tensile strength?
~6–12 months of remodeling; maximum ~80% of unwounded skin strength
